reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and the Akahu balance branch, but the replace path re-writes unlinkAccount's local reset instead of sharing it, and Fintegra's link and download are fresh copies of existing provider functions.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a verbatim copy of linkSimpleFinAccount/linkPluggyAiAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, and the db.updateAccount reset block is duplicated from unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Link guards sit in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers, the download in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config and the type in types/models; the client map edits are forced by the satisfies Record<BankSyncProviders> types.

scope.why: All edits trace to the four steps; release notes and the two client provider maps are required companions.

maintainability.why: One guard helper is called by all six providers, which keeps the link rules in one place, but it mixes assertion, not-found handling and an unlink side effect, and the provider bodies grow to six near-identical copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts performs its own db.updateAccount reset instead of reusing the local-unlink logic of unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied link body, download body and unlink reset are verbatim, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked (accounts/app.ts) gains the replaceExistingLink flag plus a closed-account branch and a replace-and-unlink branch across steps 3-4; all six link handlers still call it.
